An important update on Solflare Card.

Our card issuing partner Kulipa is winding down due to solvency issues and can no longer support Solflare Card, so cards stopped working abruptly today.

If your card declined on you at a checkout today, I'm sorry, that's a lousy way to find out. I know many of you spend with this card every day.

One thing matters above everything else: your funds are safe and there's nothing you need to do.
